# ui-usage-history

Historical token mix, spend contributions, pricing evidence and coverage.

- **Runs in:** the UI (your Emacs)
- **Source:** [lisp/ui/harness-ui-usage-history.el](../../lisp/ui/harness-ui-usage-history.el)
- **Loaded:** by default
- **Requires:** [ui-usage](ui-usage.md)
- **Brings along:** [usage-history](usage-history.md) (the rest of it), [ui](ui.md) (its file requires it)

## About

A read-only companion of the usage dashboard.  All accounting and private
log reading stays in the harness; this UI consumes usage/history over ACP.
The two denominators are displayed explicitly, and category estimates never
pretend to allocate observed bills.  See docs/design/historical-token-mix.md.

## Provides

### Commands

- `harness-ui-usage-history-back` — Return to the totals and all groups.
- `harness-ui-usage-history-cycle-group` — Select the next historical grouping.
- `harness-ui-usage-history-cycle-period` — Select the next historical period.
- `harness-ui-usage-history-help` — Show explicit accounting and coverage explanations.
- `harness-ui-usage-history-mouse-open` — Show the historical group clicked in EVENT.
- `harness-ui-usage-history-open` — Show category and pricing details for the group at point.
- `harness-ui-usage-history-refresh` — Refresh historical usage evidence.
- `harness-usage-history` — Show historical token mix and monetary evidence, without a model call.

## Uses

### Methods it calls

- `usage/history` ([usage-history](usage-history.md))

### Events it hears over ACP

- `agent/turn-ended` → `harness-ui-usage-history--event`

### Hooks it adds to

- `harness-ui-event-functions` → `harness-ui-usage-history--event`
- `harness-ui-redraw-hook` → `harness-ui-usage-history--redraw`
- `window-configuration-change-hook` → `harness-ui-usage-history--resize`
